records.text: Citing Cox’s schedule and an AV company’s LinkedIn photo, Owens said he was keynote speaker at a Rally Connects trade show in Mona at 9 a.m. on September 10.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: What is noted is that he had on the 10th, on the morning of the 10th, an event. He was the keynote speaker at the Rally Connects trade show, which was up in Mona at 9 o'clock a.m. We were able to find a photo of that on LinkedIn posted from the A.V. company that miked him, which corroborates that attendance.
